answer: Each identity bonds collateral behind an ex-ante signed independence claim before it answers. When a nebula of keys faults in the same epoch, that correlation refutes every signed claim and the whole bonded haven is jointly slashed and the committed stake burned. Clones branching from one willow root of shared control cannot assert independence yet bloc-fault together; honest unrelated keys co-fault only by chance, so the stake forfeited grows with each correlated alias and stays non-poolable across operators who countersign each other.
